description: A piece of imaging equipment an author owns: telescope, mount, camera, filter, or an all-in-one preset such as a Seestar. Images reference equipment records by strong reference.

main.description: One equipment item. Derived from the Telescope / Mount / Camera / Filter / GuideScope / GuideCamera shapes in src/lib/astronomy-utils.tsx.

kind.description: What sort of equipment this is. `preset` is an integrated smart-telescope profile (e.g. a Seestar S50) that stands in for telescope + mount + camera. Open string so new kinds (guide scopes, focusers) can be added without a schema change.

name.description: Display name as the author labels it, e.g. `Seestar S50` or `Redcat 51`.

specs.description: Free-form specifications, keyed by kind: for a telescope `apertureMm`, `focalLengthMm`, `opticalType`; for a camera `sensorWidthMm`, `sensorHeightMm`, `pixelSizeMicrons`, `resolution`; for a mount or filter `type`. Values must be DAG-CBOR encodable, so dimensions are integers in the unit the key names (microns for pixel size, millimetres otherwise).

createdAt.description: When the record was written (RFC 3339 with time zone).

equipmentRef.description: A strong (URI + CID) reference to a gallery.astra.equipment record.

cid.description: CID of the referenced equipment record at the time the reference was written.
